item.title: Why I Dropped GSD and Superpowers for Matt Pocock's Skills
item.description: I adopted Get Shit Done (GSD) and Superpowers when coding agents still needed guardrails. They worked—until GPT-5.x and Claude Opus 5.x arrived. The guardrails started capping what the model could do, and the default workflow no longer matched how I actually work. I migrated to Matt Pocock skills: small, opt-in prompts that add discipline when I need it—not a mandatory pipeline on every message.
